volumeInfo.title: The Modern Web
volumeInfo.subtitle: Multi-device Web Development with HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript
volumeInfo.description: Provides information on Web development for multiple devices, covering such topics as structure and semantics, device APIs, multimedia, and Web apps.

volumeInfo.title: The Tangled Web
volumeInfo.subtitle: A Guide to Securing Modern Web Applications
volumeInfo.description: Modern web applications are built on a tangle of technologies that have been developed over time and then haphazardly pieced together. Every piece of the web application stack, from HTTP requests to browsers, has security flaws.

volumeInfo.title: Learning Web Design
volumeInfo.subtitle: A Beginner's Guide to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Web Graphics
volumeInfo.description: Do you want to build web pages but have no prior experience? This friendly guide is the perfect place to start. You will begin at square one, learning how the web and web pages work, and then steadily build from there.

volumeInfo.title: Modern Web Development
volumeInfo.subtitle: Understanding domains, technologies, and user experience
volumeInfo.description: Master powerful new approaches to web architecture, design, and user experience. This book presents a pragmatic, up-to-date view of web development challenges and solutions.

volumeInfo.title: Eloquent JavaScript, 3rd Edition
volumeInfo.subtitle: A Modern Introduction to Programming
volumeInfo.description: Completely revised and updated, this best-selling introduction to programming in JavaScript focuses on writing real applications. JavaScript lies at the heart of almost every modern web application.

volumeInfo.title: Responsive Web Design with HTML5 and CSS
volumeInfo.subtitle: Develop future-proof responsive websites using the latest HTML5 and CSS techniques
volumeInfo.description: Publisher note: To make use of the most recent CSS and HTML features, a new, fully revised fourth edition of this book is now available, updated for 2022.

volumeInfo.title: Smashing Node.js
volumeInfo.subtitle: JavaScript Everywhere
volumeInfo.description: Learn to make more efficient apps, with just one language! Smashing Node.js: JavaScript Everywhere equips you with the necessary tools to understand Node.js and its uses in developing efficient, scalable web applications.

volumeInfo.title: CSS: The Missing Manual
volumeInfo.subtitle: Beautiful styling for the web
volumeInfo.description: CSS lets you create professional-looking websites, but learning its finer points can be tricky. This fully updated edition provides the most modern and effective tips, tricks, and tutorial-based instruction.

volumeInfo.title: High Performance Web Sites
volumeInfo.subtitle: Essential Knowledge for Front-End Engineers
volumeInfo.description: Want your web site to display more quickly? This book presents 14 specific rules that will cut 25% to 50% off response time when users request a page.

volumeInfo.title: HTML5: Up and Running
volumeInfo.subtitle: Dive into the Future of Web Development
volumeInfo.description: If you do not know about the new features available in HTML5, now is the time to find out. This book provides practical information about how and why the latest version of this markup language is significantly changing the way you develop for the Web.
